panels.title: Manifold pressure
panels.description: Gauge pressure: the ECU's absolute reading less 101.3 kPa, in psi, so vacuum reads negative and boost positive.

panels.title: Fuel pressure
panels.description: Gauge pressure in psi, converted from the ECU's kPa in-panel.

panels.title: Fuel level
panels.description: Haltech FUEL_LEVEL as reported by the ECU, in litres. Colour steps are a generic low-fuel warning; the strategy service on the Fuel dashboard owns the real laps-to-dry call.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value AS "Surge switch" FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.surge_tank_switch' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Fuel status
panels.description: Surge tank float switch (PDM16 SPI 1). 5 V with fuel in the surge tank; below 2.5 V the surge light is on and the panel turns red and reads LOW FUEL. Shows the newest sample in the database on every dashboard refresh, because the switch only reports every 5 s and a streaming panel sits on No data between reports. If the car drops offline this holds its last reading.

The strategy service's counter-based fuel remaining: the last anchor (full tank, operator fuel mark, or the surge switch closing, which re-anchors to 1.8 L) minus the Haltech fuel-used counter since then, carried across engine restarts. Updates about once a lap. It only rises after a stop once the refuel is recorded in session control.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, fuel_remaining_l AS "Fuel remaining" FROM v_strategy_history WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND vehicle_id = '$vehicle' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
